search.idle: Enter a search term to find your chats.
search.failed: Search could not be completed. Try again.
search.invalidPhrase: Put words between matching quotation marks to search for an exact phrase.
search.textOnly: Text search only · search by meaning is unavailable

projects.title: Filter by project
settings.title: Settings
settings.error: Indexing needs attention. Check your sources or try repairing the index.
settings.modelMissing: Not installed · text search still works
settings.failed: The local service is unavailable. Restart BetterSearch and try again.
navigation.unavailable: The original chat is not available on this computer.
navigation.failed: The original chat could not be opened.
host.required: Open BetterSearch from your conversation’s New Tab menu.
host.unsupported: Update your desktop app to use BetterSearch.
settings.archivedHelp: Show archived conversations in search results.
settings.sourcesHelp: Choose the local Codex profiles to search. Original chats stay unchanged.
settings.sourcePending: Ready for the next index update
settings.sourceDisabled: Excluded from search and future indexing
settings.sourceWarning: Source needs attention. Check that its folder is available.
settings.automaticHelp: Check for changed chats every 15 minutes. Turning this off lets current work finish.
settings.efficientHelp: Uses fewer resources, with more breaks between updates.
settings.balancedHelp: Balances background resource use and update speed.
settings.fastHelp: Catches up sooner, using more resources while updating.
settings.localModelHelp: Finds related wording using a model in your shared Hugging Face cache. Downloading it does not send your chats to the provider.
settings.downloadInfo: About 533 MB · downloaded from Hugging Face
settings.modelError: Installation failed. Check your connection and retry.
settings.modelBusyHelp: Pause indexing and wait for its current step to finish before checking the model.
settings.agentHelp: Agents can retrieve excerpts from your chats. Those excerpts become context in their current conversation.
settings.languageHelp: English is currently available. Search works across languages. Appearance follows your app theme.
settings.repairDescription: Refresh missing search data. Rebuild or clear only when needed; both create a backup first.
settings.rebuildHelp: A local backup is created first. The active index and embeddings will be recreated from enabled sources. Original Codex chats and downloaded models stay intact.
settings.clearHelp: A local backup is created first. The active search index is emptied and indexing is paused. Original Codex chats, downloaded models and existing backups stay intact.
settings.diagnosticsHelp: Export includes version, counts and service state. It excludes chat content, tokens, source labels and private paths.
settings.saveFailed: The change could not be saved. Check the local service and try again.
settings.busy: Indexing is still finishing a step. Pause it, wait a moment, then try again.
settings.isPaused: Resume indexing before running this action.
settings.invalidSource: Choose a folder containing a supported local Codex profile.
settings.sourceExists: This Codex profile is already in your sources.
settings.invalidLabel: Enter a source name between 1 and 100 characters.
settings.dialogFailed: The system file dialog could not be opened. Check that a desktop session is available and try again.
settings.neverUpdated: Waiting for the first index update
settings.healthHelp: Disabled sources are excluded from results; their existing indexed data is retained.
